https://www.theguardian.com/football/202.title: Manchester United produce comeback for the ages as Cunha double floors Roma
https://www.theguardian.com/football/202.author: David Hytner at Old Trafford
https://www.theguardian.com/football/202.text:
Michael Carrick enjoyed one of his finest nights as a Manchester United player in the Champions League against Roma, scoring twice in a 7-1 win in the quarter-final, second leg in 2007. The re-run here was all about his managerial survival at the club.
The situation looked impossibly grim for him at half-time. Amid an atmosphere of continued fan anger towards the United ownership, Carrick’s team had been implausibly bad. Roma took a 2-0 lead into the break and the truth was that the scoreline greatly flattered United.
What happened next was a fightback for the ages. For Carrick, it might even have topped 2007. United’s defending had been so loose, so generous. But they finally showed the other side to their game – the one about attacking punch; derring-do. They found a solution to their woes at the back. Keep the ball in the other half.
Matheus Cunha was the hero and it said plenty about the chaos of this game, the wildness of the emotions, that he ended up being sent off for a second yellow card in the 90th minute for a lunge at Leonardo Balerdi.
Before that, he had supplemented a Bruno Fernandes penalty – which the captain converted after a retake – with a touch and finish following an error from Balerdi. Cunha’s second goal, which proved to be the winner, was hammered in off the near post after a pass from the substitute, Shea Lacey. Cunha’s first touch to control was a beauty.
The United support sing about having seen it all. This was just extraordinary. Can it save Carrick? He will go into Sunday’s Premier League game at home against Aston Villa with renewed belief.
The fragility of the United backline has been well documented. How the hierarchy decided that it did not need any reinforcements over the summer is beyond belief. With Luke Shaw still injured, Carrick was forced to persist with Diogo Dalot out of position at left-back.
Dalot pushed very high at the outset, which felt bold. It was plainly a demand from Carrick. Dalot’s positioning was pure folly on the opening Roma goal. The visitors transitioned quickly, far too quickly for United’s ponderous defence and when Rodrigo Mora looked up from the inside left, all he could see was Matías Soulé in acres of space on the opposite channel. Where was Dalot? Mora played the pass. Soulé took a touch and swept past the exposed Senne Lammens.
United’s defending for the second goal was even worse. Leny Yoro turned and ran back towards his own goal as Roma advanced up the left, and when the move appeared to have broken down for them around the United box, there was Harry Maguire to gift it back to Soulé with a dreadful miskick. Soulé dropped his shoulder and shot; the ball hit Ayden Heaven’s hand and Donyell Malen converted from the spot. Again, Dalot had been high up the pitch.
The mutiny could be felt before kick-off; the sounds of it heard. There were the green and gold balloons of protest against the Glazers. The relentless chants against the club’s owners. When the clock showed 20 minutes and five seconds – or 2005; the year of the Glazer takeover – the Stretford End erupted in a planned move; hurling tennis balls down on to the pitch.
Moments earlier, a grisly Dalot error on the ball had almost led to Malen getting in for a third and the first half was just an ordeal for United. Roma were well organised in their 3-4-2-1 shape and they got in up the inside right time and again. They might have had many more before the interval; Mora, Malen and Soulé all went close.
United offered minimal resistance. They were so easy to play through. There was nervousness from them on the ball, heavy touches. A glaring lack of cohesion. What was the plan? When Bruno Fernandes had a half-chance on the edge of the box in the 43th minute, he could not sort out his feet and blazed high.
Carrick was in the last chance saloon during half-time. He had to have a simple demand of his players: show some fight. There had been no evidence of it in the first period. Yet United emerged with purpose.
Carrick lost Carlos Baleba in the 46th minute. The midfielder stormed into the Roma area and was about to shoot only to pull his hamstring. Then, United caught a break – two, actually – and the mood shifted sharply.
It was a soft penalty award for a push by Gianluca Mancini on Cunha after he played a give-and-go with Fernandes. But when United had that sinking feeling after Fernandes saw his kick saved by Devis Vásquez, they were reprieved when the referee, Jesús Gil Manzano, ordered a retake for encroachment. Fernandes lashed it home.
United came alive. Bryan Mbeumo, played through by Cunha for a one-on-one with Vásquez, saw his shot hit one post and then the other one before refusing to cross the line. United threatened from corners. Maguire went close. Dalot had a header cleared off the line.
The United support had endured that familiar wrestle before kick-off; trying to find hope in face of the negativity, the deep sense of foreboding. Kobbie Mainoo’s return to the starting XI provided a glimmer. He was in the mood to make his moves.
Carrick’s major selection decision was to start Heaven over Lisandro Martínez in central defence. It shone a light into Martínez’s current headspace. It is a dark place. Martínez would get on for Heaven towards the end.
United fought. It was shocking to see how Roma, unbeaten so far this season in Serie A, fell apart. Cunha made the difference. United deal only in the craziest of extremes.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Pabllo Vittar recebe homenagem da Assembleia Legislativa de Minas Gerais
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Redação
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
A Comissão de Direitos Humanos da Assembleia Legislativa de Minas Gerais (ALMG) aprovou, no dia 28 de outubro, um requerimento de voto de congratulações para a cantora e drag queen Pabllo Vittar. A iniciativa foi da deputada estadual Andréia de Jesus (PT), que destacou o papel da artista na promoção da democracia, dos direitos da população LGBTIA+ e da visibilidade da comunidade.
Embora a homenagem ainda precise ser aprovada pelo plenário da casa, Andréia de Jesus entregou a Pabllo Vittar uma honraria simbólica no último sábado (31) durante a passagem da cantora por Belo Horizonte para o show da turnê “Halloween da Pabllo”.
O momento também foi acompanhado por Iuri Santos, ativista dos direitos humanos. A parlamentar, que é vice-presidente da Comissão de Direitos Humanos e da Comissão de Cultura na ALMG, compartilhou a entrega pelas redes sociais e destacou que “Pabllo Vittar é muito mais que uma artista, é uma referência de representatividade para toda a população LGBTQIA+”.
Em 2024, Vittar se tornou a primeira drag queen brasileira a entrar na parada global das 50 músicas mais ouvidas do Spotify. Também foi a segunda drag queen do mundo — depois de RuPaul — a entrar na parada da revista americana Billboard. Além das marcas de sucesso, a artista também é conhecida pelo posicionamento político à esquerda, defendendo pautas populares, a democracia e os direitos humanos.
Ao receber a homenagem, Pabllo Vittar afirmou estar feliz com o reconhecimento de seu trabalho e honrada por saber que sua arte inspira tantas pessoas. A cantora reiterou que continuará usando sua voz para dar visibilidade às pautas da população LGBTQIA+.

https://taz.de/Opferberatung-in-Sachsen-.title: Opferberatung in Sachsen-Anhalt: Zum Jubiläum braucht es Solidarität
https://taz.de/Opferberatung-in-Sachsen-.author: David Muschenich
https://taz.de/Opferberatung-in-Sachsen-.text:
Opferberatung in Sachsen-Anhalt: Zum Jubiläum braucht es Solidarität
Seit 25 Jahren unterstützt die Mobile Opferberatung Betroffene rechter Gewalt. Doch ein Thema trübt die Freude bei der Jubiläumsfeier.
Zwei goldene Ballons schweben im Scheinwerferlicht auf der Bühne, gemeinsam bilden sie die Zahl 25. Darunter stehen drei Blumensträuße. Die Mobile Opferberatung Sachsen-Anhalt feiert Dienstagnachmittag ihren 25. Geburtstag. Es gibt alkoholfreien Sekt, Pommes, Falafel. Rund 100 Gäst:innen lauschen in einem kleinen Theater in Halle (Saale) den Festreden. Und es gibt viel zu loben: detaillierte Statistiken zu rechter Gewalt, mehr als 13.000 Beratungen von Betroffenen. Trotzdem ist die Stimmung gedrückt.
Nach der Landtagswahl im September ist unklar, wie lange es für die Opferberatung in Sachsen-Anhalt weitergeht. Die AfD, die bei der Wahl rund 44 Prozent der Stimmen bekam, könnte ab nächstem Monat die Regierung anführen. Schon in ihrem Wahlprogramm hatte sie angekündigt, dem Verein Miteinander, zu dem die Mobile Opferberatung gehört, die finanzielle Grundlage zu entziehen.
Am Dienstagnachmittag in Halle benennt jede einzelne Rede diesen Umstand. Die Soziologin Katharina Warda und die Schriftstellerin Manja Präkels zeigen zudem auf, wie der Rechtsruck in der Gesellschaft sichtbar wird, welche Parallelen es zu den 90ern gibt, zu den sogenannten Baseballschlägerjahren. Und sie stellen dem etwas entgegen: Solidarität. „Solange es ein Wir gibt, gewinnen wir“, sagt Katharina Warda. „Genaugenommen ist sich wehren Pflicht“, sagt Präkels.
Aus diesen Gedanken heraus entstand auch vor 25 Jahren die Mobile Opferberatung in Sachsen-Anhalt. Die Mitarbeiter:innen beraten Betroffene rechter Gewalt beim Umgang mit der Erfahrung, begleiten sie etwa bei den Strafverfahren ins Gericht und versuchen, vor Ort die Situation so zu verbessern, dass Angriffe unwahrscheinlicher werden. Dabei ergreift die Beratung Partei, übernimmt die Perspektive der Betroffenen.
Finanzierung in Gefahr
Es geht um Fälle wie etwa Mitte Mai 2026, als drei Männer in der Straßenbahn zwei Jugendliche erst rassistisch beleidigen, dann ins Gesicht schlagen und schließlich mit einer abgebrochenen Bierflasche verletzen. Oder um den Fall aus dem Januar, als dem Organisator eines CSDs in einer Kneipe auf dem Weg zur Toilette zuhören bekommt, man solle ihn ins KZ stecken. Solche Angriffe sammelt die Mobile Opferberatung in ihrer Chronik, veröffentlicht sie. Durch die jährliche Statistik macht sie nachvollziehbar, wie sich rechte Gewalt in Sachsen-Anhalt entwickelt.
Auf dem Jubiläumsfest in Halle hält zunächst Susi Möbbeck (SPD) eine Rede als Staatssekretärin des Sozialministeriums der geschäftsführenden Landesregierung von Sachsen-Anhalt. Die Bilanz der Opferberatung zeige wie notwendig deren Arbeit sei. „Sie hören zu, wenn andere wegsehen“, lobt Möbbeck.
Doch auch Möbbeck zeigt sich besorgt. „Wir müssen damit rechnen, dass die Landesförderung über kurze oder mittlere Frist komplett abbrechen.“ In den kommenden Wochen gehe es darum, die Förderung zumindest für nächstes Jahr abzusichern, sagt sie. Was sie nicht sagt: Weil die Finanzierung bislang nicht gesichert ist, musste die Opferberatung ihre Mitarbeiter:innen vorerst kündigen.
Kurz darauf erscheint Elisabeth Kaiser (SPD), die Ostbeauftragte der Bundesregierung, per Videobotschaft im Theater. Früher seien die Opfer rechter Gewalt allein gewesen, nicht ernst genommen worden. Heute stehe die Opferberatung an deren Seite. In den schwierigen Zeiten wolle Kaiser deshalb in der Bundesregierung für Unterstützung der Zivilgesellschaft einsetzen, damit die auch die Opferberatung weiter arbeiten kann. „Bleiben Sie ein Ort für alle, die nach einem Angriff nicht alleingelassen werden dürfen“, gratuliert sie abschließend nochmal zum Jubiläum.
Nach zwei Stunden voller Reden folgt auf der Bühne in Halle ein kurzer Umbau und dann eine Diskussionsrunde. Auf die Frage, was mit der Mobilen Opferberatung verloren gehen würde, antwortet Rechtsanwalt Sebastian Scharmer: Die Perspektive der Betroffenen habe bei staatlichen Behörden immer noch kein prägendes Gewicht. Oft werde noch nicht einmal die politische Motivation von Angriffen erkannt.
Dem widerspricht dann Antje Arndt, Projektleiterin der Mobilen Opferberatung Sachsen-Anhalt – zumindest ein bisschen. In den vergangenen Jahren habe sich einiges geändert. „Wir können auf Augenhöhe mit Vertretern der Polizei und Politik reden“, sagt sie. Ihre Sorge sei, dass unter einer AfD-Regierung auch solche Ansprechpartner:innen verschwinden könnten.
Was es jetzt brauche, sagt Arndt etwas später noch der taz, sei „Solidarität auf allen Ebenen“. Dabei dürften vor allem die nicht vergessen werden, die unter einer AfD-Regierung besonders leiden würden: Die Opfer rechter Gewalt.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Lula vai a São Paulo para fazer exames de rotina nesta terça-feira
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Elaine Patricia Cruz
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
O presidente da República, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), viajará a São Paulo no final da tarde desta terça-feira (3) para fazer exames de rotina. A informação foi confirmada nesta tarde pela Secretaria de Comunicação Social da Presidência da República.
Em comunicado à imprensa, a secretaria informou que os exames já estavam pré-agendados para serem realizados logo após a eleição. A previsão é que sejam realizados na noite de hoje, sob a coordenação dos médicos Roberto Kalil Filho e Ana Helena Germoglio.
Lula deve retornar a Brasília na manhã de quarta-feira (4), seguindo com sua agenda normal de trabalho.
Em abril deste ano, Lula passou por uma cirurgia para retirar uma lesão no couro cabeludo, um carcinoma basocelular. É considerado o tipo mais comum de câncer de pele, já que responde por cerca de 80% dos casos, e o menos agressivo – na maioria das vezes, tem crescimento lento e raramente se dissemina para outras partes do corpo. Em maio, passou por sessões de radioterapia preventiva.

https://taz.de/Angriffe-auf-Kuehlanlagen.title: Angriffe auf Kühlanlagen: Eiskalt erwischt
https://taz.de/Angriffe-auf-Kuehlanlagen.author: Tanja Tricarico
https://taz.de/Angriffe-auf-Kuehlanlagen.text:
Angriffe auf Kühlanlagen : Eiskalt erwischt
Die Cyberattacken zeigen, wie verwundbar unsere Versorgung mit Lebensmitteln ist. Und wie sehr der Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur vernachlässigt wird.
E s gibt Attacken, die lassen uns kurz staunen und verschwinden dann wieder aus der persönlichen Wahrnehmung. Und es gibt Attacken, die für Hilflosigkeit und Verunsicherung sorgen. Letzteres haben die Täter:innen hinter den Cyberangriffen auf Kühlsysteme in etlichen Supermärkten Europas auf jeden Fall geschafft.
Unsere Versorgung mit Lebensmitteln ist verwundbar – und dies offenbar mit recht einfachen Mitteln. In Frankreich wurden bereits Anfang Oktober digitale Steuerungssysteme von Gefriertruhen und Kühlschränken in Einkaufsläden aus der Ferne manipuliert. Jetzt folgen Schweden, Italien, Belgien, Estland, Finnland und Deutschland.
Statt gekühlt wurden die Lebensmittel eher gegart, auf soften 50 Grad. Die Nahrungsmittel haben die Hitzeattacke nicht überlebt und mussten größtenteils entsorgt werden. Der verursachte Gesamtschaden dürfte Hunderttausende Euro betragen.
taz debatte
Die taz ist eine unabhängige, linke und meinungsstarke Tageszeitung. In unseren Kommentaren, Essays und Debattentexten streiten wir seit der Gründung der taz im Jahr 1979. Oft können und wollen wir uns nicht auf eine Meinung einigen. Deshalb finden sich hier teils komplett gegenläufige Positionen – allesamt Teil des sehr breiten linken Meinungsspektrums.
Die Lebensmittelversorgung und damit auch die Kühlketten zählen zur kritischen Infrastruktur, die besonders im Fokus von Supermarktinhabern und Firmen stehen müssen. So schreiben es entsprechende Gesetze vor. Doch selbst in hoch digitalisierten Zeiten, in denen Begriffe wie hybride Kriegsführung, Sabotageakte oder Cyberkriminalität zum Standardrepertoire möglicher Gefahrenlagen gehören, ist die Sicherung solcher Systeme offenbar noch immer nicht ganz oben auf der Agenda der Unternehmen angekommen.
Gibt es unabhängige Netzwerke, die Versorgungskreise voneinander trennen? Sind die Passwörter sicher, um auf die digitalen Systeme zuzugreifen, und gibt es einen „doppelten Boden“, also eine alternative Überwachung der Kühlung? Vielleicht sogar ganz menschlich, also in Form von Personal, das die Temperaturen ab und an kontrolliert? Ganz zu schweigen von Notfallplänen, wenn ein System ausfällt.
Erschreckend sind in den aktuellen Fällen sowohl die politischen Antworten als auch die Äußerungen der Unternehmen, so naiv und hilflos, wie sie daherkommen. Es brauche mehr Anstrengung beim Schutz von digitaler Gebäude- und Betriebstechnik, sagt etwa Digitalminister Karsten Wildberger (CDU). Und Firmen stellen überrascht fest, dass im KI-Zeitalter Attacken diffiziler, schneller und durchschlagender werden. Tja, wer hätte gedacht, dass Digitalisierung nicht nur Personalkosten einspart, sondern auch Nebenwirkungen hat.
Noch ist unklar, wer hinter den Cyberattacken steckt. War es Sabotage – gar initiiert von „fremden Mächten“? War es gewöhnliche Kriminalität von Täter:innen, die die Inhaber der Supermärkte erpressen wollen? Klar ist, dass mehr Bewusstsein für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur nicht bloß eine Option ist, sondern alternativlos.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Deputados do DF criticam aumento do ICMS e preços de hospedagens para posse de Lula
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Kennedy Cruz
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
O reajuste do Imposto sobre Circulação de Mercadorias e Serviços (ICMS) sobre combustíveis e os preços elevados das hospedagens para a posse do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) foram temas de críticas de deputados distritais durante sessão da Câmara Legislativa do Distrito Federal (CLDF), nesta terça-feira (3). Os parlamentares questionaram o impacto das decisões sobre o orçamento da população e cobraram providências do Governo do Distrito Federal (GDF).
O aumento do ICMS foi aprovado pelo Conselho Nacional de Política Fazendária (Confaz), em reunião realizada no dia 27 de outubro, dois dias depois do segundo turno das eleições. Os novos valores começam a valer em 1º de fevereiro de 2027. O aumento será de 11,1% para o diesel, 4,8% para o gás de cozinha e 4,5% para a gasolina.
O Confaz reúne representantes das secretarias de Fazenda dos estados e do Distrito Federal, além do governo federal. São os governos estaduais e o DF que definem conjuntamente os valores do imposto. Na reunião, o Distrito Federal foi representado pelo secretário de Economia, Fabrízio Gomes dos Santos.
Participação dos governos estaduais
A decisão foi questionada pelo deputado distrital Chico Vigilante (PT), que criticou a participação dos governos estaduais na aprovação do reajuste. “Não é justo que, enquanto o presidente Lula vem subsidiando o preço dos combustíveis para que não aumente, esses secretários se reúnam e decidam que o cidadão vai pagar mais nos seus estados. Não tem nenhum motivo para aumentar o ICMS”, afirmou.
Vigilante também cobrou um posicionamento da governadora Celina Leão (PP) e defendeu que o GDF não acompanhe a decisão do Confaz. Em 22 de outubro, cinco dias antes da reunião, Celina havia declarado compromisso de não aumentar impostos sobre combustíveis e defendido a manutenção de alíquotas menores.
“Está na hora da governadora Celina se juntar ao povo e peitar a decisão do secretário de Economia, que participou desse convescote. Esses secretários não tiveram um voto sequer e não têm compromisso direto com a sociedade. Aproveitam essas reuniões para decidir quanto cada cidadão vai pagar e depois metem a mão no nosso bolso. Não vamos aceitar isso”, declarou o parlamentar.
O deputado afirmou que pretende apresentar uma proposta na CLDF para impedir a aplicação do reajuste no Distrito Federal e disse que solicitou um estudo sobre as possibilidades de atuação legislativa. A iniciativa, segundo ele, busca mobilizar os demais parlamentares contra a elevação do imposto.
O deputado distrital Max Maciel (Psol) também chamou atenção para a responsabilidade dos governos estaduais e alertou que parte da população tem atribuído o aumento ao governo federal. “O aumento do ICMS não é uma determinação do governo federal. Pelo contrário, é uma decisão dos estados, são os governos estaduais que deliberam sobre o aumento. Vários candidatos a governador disseram que não iriam aumentar o ICMS, e o Distrito Federal também sinalizou esse compromisso. Por isso, queremos deixar esse recado para a população: é importante compreender de onde vem essa decisão e quem é responsável por ela”, disse.
Max também lembrou que a CLDF aprovou medidas para reduzir o ICMS sobre o diesel e defendeu a manutenção dessa política, além de sua extensão aos demais combustíveis. “Nós aprovamos, inclusive nesta Casa, a possibilidade de redução do ICMS sobre o diesel, para evitar que os preços cheguem a patamares exorbitantes. Queremos que essa medida seja mantida e também estendida aos demais combustíveis no Distrito Federal”, afirmou Max Maciel.
Hospedagens chegam a R$ 25 mil
Outro assunto que mobilizou os deputados foi o aumento dos preços das hospedagens em Brasília durante o período da posse presidencial, marcada para o dia 5 de janeiro. Um levantamento publicado pelo portal Metrópoles nesta terça-feira (3) identificou diárias de até R$ 25,3 mil em hotéis da capital, além de aumentos que chegam a 4.786% na comparação com períodos de preços habituais. Ao menos dez estabelecimentos apresentaram valores superiores a R$ 9 mil.
Chico Vigilante criticou os valores cobrados pelo setor hoteleiro e afirmou que os preços podem afastar pessoas interessadas em acompanhar a cerimônia. O deputado disse que vai acionar a Secretaria Nacional do Consumidor (Senacon), vinculada ao Ministério da Justiça, e o Procon-DF para solicitar providências.
“Tem hotel cobrando R$ 25 mil em uma diária. No centro, houve aumento de até 1.000% nas diárias. É um absurdo o que estão fazendo com as pessoas que querem vir assistir à posse. Não podemos aceitar passivamente esse tipo de posicionamento por parte do setor hoteleiro. É simplesmente inaceitável aumentar os preços para que as pessoas não venham assistir à posse do presidente Lula”, afirmou o parlamentar.
O deputado distrital Fábio Felix (Psol), recém-eleito deputado federal, também cobrou fiscalização e afirmou que os valores encontrados durante o período da cerimônia são incompatíveis com o direito dos consumidores. “O Código de Defesa do Consumidor prevê que essas práticas abusivas do ponto de vista do mercado não podem ser aplicadas dessa forma. Não se trata apenas de uma questão logística ou operacional. Estamos falando de um momento de participação da sociedade civil, de participação do povo”, disse.
Fábio Felix defendeu que a Secretaria de Turismo e o Procon-DF atuem para apurar as cobranças. “As pessoas querem participar desse momento e não podemos tolerar que nossa cidade receba essas pessoas da forma como está recebendo, com práticas de mercado absolutamente abusivas do nosso setor hoteleiro. Nós podemos atuar sobre isso e queremos que o governo do Distrito Federal também tome providências”, afirmou o deputado.

https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/mi.title: Miquel Navarro, Sculptor of Large-Scale, Pared-Down Cities and Valencia’s Beloved ‘Pink Panther,’ Dies at 81
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/mi.author: Maximilíano Durón
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/mi.text:
Miquel Navarro, a sculptor known for his pared-down installation of cities that reflected on the promises of modernity in the latter-half of the 20th century, died on Sunday at 81 in Mislata, Spain, after a long illness, reports El País.
Navarro’s hometown of Mislata, just outside València, served as a never-ending source of inspiration for him throughout his career. “The city that inspired part of his imagery was also where he lived, worked, and developed much of his creative process. From his studio in the Morería neighborhood, the artist built a universal career without ever relinquishing his connection to the land where he grew up,” the Mislata City Council said in a statement announcing his death.
Part of a generation of Spanish artists who came to prominence in the 1980s, Navarro would make his first “City” sculpture in 1973, two years before the Franco regime ended. “In the fifties, I would approach the city on a tram, and the encounter with it was fascinating,” he told El País in 2009 of his inspiration for the decades-long series.
Meant to be walked around and through, these installations feature first dozens and then hundreds of elements in various shapes, from cuboids and truncated pyramids representing rows of homes or the campuses of factories to soaring cylinders and columns, stand-ins for skyscrapers.
“Even my most schematic sculptures, without entirely abandoning the figurative, always bear the marks of man,” he once said of his “Cities.” The earliest of these would be comprised of dozens of pieces of clay, though he would later fabricate his “Cities” from metals like aluminum and iron.
While some portions of the installation show the rigid order of a city grid, other parts feature elements strewn about, toppled over—a metaphor for the parts of the urban environment that can’t be as easily organized.
“Navarro’s cities generate arenas for the confrontation of ideas. Throughout his career, he has continually proposed a revision of our notions of space, construction, place, and of our own bodies as a singular measure of the human and the city,” reads an exhibition description for the Guggenheim Museum’s 2004 display of his Wall City (1995–2000), which had recently been acquired by the Guggenheim Bilbao.
A few years later, Navarro would offer another reading to his sculptures: “Eroticism is a very important part of my work,” Navarro told El Mundo in a 2009 interview. “On the one hand, it is represented by the totem pole, which is not only a human, phallic element, but a symbol of solitude and power, as is the case with skyscrapers.”
Calling him a “beloved son of Mistlata,” the Mislata City Council declared three days of official mourning from November 1–3, describing him as “one of the great figures of contemporary Spanish art, whose work has achieved international recognition and whose name will forever remain linked to the history, identity and collective memory of his hometown.”
Miquel Narravo was born on September 29, 1945, in Mislata. In 1964, he first took up painting and drawing before devoting himself exclusively to sculpture in 1974, according to a chronology produced by the Guggenheim Bilbao. He studied fine arts at the Escuela Superior de Bellas Artes de San Carlos in Valencia before dropping out in 1968, the year he participated in a group exhibition, “Nuestro yo,” at Círculo Universitario de Valencia.
In 1972, the year of his first solo show, Navarro begins working in sculpture before debuting his first “City” sculpture, La ciutat (1973–74), the following year at the Galería Val i 30 in Valencia.
Navarro would gain international attention for his inclusion in the 1980 exhibition “New Images from Spain” at the Guggenheim Museum in New York. In 1986, he would represent Spain at the Venice Biennale, alongside other artists of his generation, Ferran García Sevilla, José María Sicilia, and Cristina Iglesias. That same year, he won the Premio Nacional de Artes Plásticas (National Award for Plastic Arts), Spain’s top award for artists, given out by the Ministry of Culture. A 1989 exhibition at the Reina Sofía would see his 55-foot sculpture Minerva paranoica (Paranoid Minerva) installed in Madrid’s Palacio de Cristal.
The mid-1980s would also see Navarro engage in public sculpture, with the installation of his towering 75-foot painted-iron water fountain Fuente Pública (Public Fountain, 1986) in Valencia, meant to commemorate “the transfer of water from the Júcar River to Valencia,” per the Guggenheim Bilbao. The now-iconic sculpture would lovingly be called by its citizens La Pantera Rosa (The Pink Panther), for the pinkish hue it would get over the years and its resemblance to the cartoon character.
He would go on to make several other sculptures for cities across Spain and abroad. For Barcelona, he created Fraternitat (Fraternity, 1992), and for his hometown he would make three public works: Cabeza con luna menguante (Head with Waning Moon, 2001), L’Almassil (2010), and Caminante (Walker, 2022).
His love for Mislata and Valencia would see him donate hundreds of works for the public to enjoy. In 2005, he gave 530 works to the Institut Valencià d’Art Modern (IVAM). Then, in 2020, he created the Fundació Miquel Navarro to preserve his legacy, seeding it with a donation of over 400 works, including several “Cities” installations. Sited in his longtime studio, a 10,800-square-foot former warehouse that he moved into in the 1980s, the foundation opened to the public this past June the artist’s Casa-Taller (House-Workshop) to show some of the donated works.
“Today Mislata has bid farewell not only to a universal artist, but also to a generous and humble friend, a person deeply connected to this city,” Mislata mayor Carlos F. Bielsa said in a statement. “His House-Studio will always be the legacy and the greatest treasure we have to preserve and cherish his memory.

https://taz.de/Bilger-fuer-Handyblitzer/.title: Bilger für Handyblitzer: Das Problem am falschen Ende angepackt
https://taz.de/Bilger-fuer-Handyblitzer/.author: Klaudia Lagozinski
https://taz.de/Bilger-fuer-Handyblitzer/.text:
Bilger für Handyblitzer : Das Problem am falschen Ende angepackt
Der Verkehrsminister will mit Monocams gegen Handysünder vorgehen. Geht es um Sicherheit oder um eine PR-Aktion und den KI-Trend?
D ass Verkehrsminister Steffen Bilger mit Monocams verstärkt gegen Personen vorgehen will, die das Handy am Steuer benutzen, ist angesichts der Zahl von gut 1.000 Unfällen im Jahr schon plausibel. Der Blick auf die gesamten Unfallstatistiken lässt den Plan allerdings schon eher wie ein pseudohippes „Schaut mal her, wir machen auch was mit KI“ erscheinen. Ginge es primär um die Sicherheit, müsste zuallererst das Problem im Zentrum stehen, das zu mehr als 14 Mal so vielen Unfällen auf den Straßen führt wie Smartphones: Alkohol.
Laut Statistischem Bundesamt kam es im Jahr 2024 alle 15 Minuten zu einem Unfall, bei dem hochprozentige Getränke im Spiel waren. Bilgers geplante Einführung der Handyblitzer setzt an der falschen Stelle an. Dazu kommt das Problem, dass – anders als beim Tempoblitzer – schon fotografiert wird, bevor ein Verstoß überhaupt feststeht. So könnte schon ein verdächtig in der Hand gehaltener Kaffeebecher den Blitzer auslösen. Solche Aufnahmen müssen dann händisch von Beamten geprüft werden. Es wäre also weiterhin menschliches Zutun nötig.
Anstelle der Handyblitzer wäre es viel sinnvoller, eine weit größere Stellschraube auf die Agenda zu schreiben und verdachtsunabhängige, verpflichtende Alkoholtests einzuführen. Rechtlich ist das aktuell leider bisher nicht möglich, wäre aber ein großer Gewinn für mehr Sicherheit auf den Straßen. Denkbar wäre Random Breath Testing nach australischem Modell. So würde die Polizei auch weniger Daten sammeln.

Das Smartphoneproblem wird sich auf kurz oder lang von selbst lösen, denn in Neuwagen lässt sich das Handy leicht mit der vorhandenen Freisprechanlage koppeln. Aber wenn schon die Handysünder ins Visier genommen werden, dann doch bitte richtig. Im Monocam-Land Niederlande kostet das Smartphone am Steuer 440 Euro, nicht wie hier nur rund 130 Euro. https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: PEC da Segurança permitirá ter uma política nacional que será eficaz no combate às facções, avalia ex-ouvidor da polícia de SP
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Larissa Bohrer
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
O Senado analisa nesta terça-feira (3) a PEC da Segurança Pública, que prevê uma cooperação entre União, estados e municípios para a área, em especial no que diz respeito ao combate ao crime organizado. O governo Lula está trabalhando para passar a proposta sem incluir a redução da maioridade penal para 16 anos em casos de crimes hediondos.
Ao Conexão BdF, da Rádio Brasil de Fato, o ex-ouvidor das polícias de São Paulo, Benedito Mariano, que integra a coordenação do escritório do Ministério da Justiça e da Segurança Pública em São Paulo, avalia que a mudança será bastante positiva, porque dará maior participação do governo nessa agenda.
“O presidente Lula tem reforçado que o artigo 144 da Constituição Federal, basicamente, colocou a centralização da segurança pública para os estados federados e o Distrito Federal. Quando tem uma PEC que amplia a participação do governo federal na segurança pública, é para que a União estabeleça diretrizes gerais de uma política nacional de segurança pública. Em toda a transição democrática, nós não tivemos diretrizes gerais a partir da União para os estados, municípios e para o Distrito Federal”, explica.
Mariano avalia que a criação do Ministério da Segurança Pública dará lastro para ações coordenadas e que isso vai fortalecer especialmente o combate ao crime organizado. “A principal diretriz é fortalecer o enfrentamento às facções criminosas que cresceram no país inteiro, estão ocupando vários territórios. Essa é a agenda principal da segurança pública, incluindo uma política consistente de proteção às mulheres e enfrentamento ao feminicídio”, pontua.
Segundo o especialista, há alguns outros pontos fortes na PEC, um deles é o fortalecimento dos órgãos de controle interno das polícias, as corregedorias, criando autonomia para os órgãos corregedores. “O crime organizado se organiza muito com a participação de agentes do Estado, portanto, é importante o fortalecimento dos órgãos de controle”, destaca.
Outro aspecto positivo, continua Mariano, é a constitucionalização do Fundo Nacional de Segurança Pública, evitando que ele sofra cortes. “É importante ter muitos recursos para a agenda de segurança pública. E o principal ponto é que o governo federal vai passar a estabelecer efetivamente a política nacional de segurança pública”, reforça.
E, por fim, Benedito Mariano elogia o eixo de asfixia financeira no combate às organizações criminosas. “É o andar de cima do crime que alimenta as ações violentas do crime nas periferias, nos morros. Portanto, tem que ter uma ação concomitante de enfrentamento ao crime no andar de cima e, gradativamente, ir retomando os territórios ocupados pelo crime com uma pasta específica da segurança pública”, defende.
Para ouvir e assistir
O jornal Conexão BdF vai ao ar em duas edições, de segunda a sexta-feira: a primeira às 12h e a segunda às 17h, na Rádio Brasil de Fato, 98.9 FM na Grande São Paulo, com transmissão simultânea também pelo YouTube do Brasil de Fato.

https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/it.title: Italy Looks to Join Its European Counterparts With Restitution Legislation
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/it.author: Hikmat Mohammed
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/it.text:
Italy is joining other European countries, including Germany, Austria, France, the Netherlands, the UK, and Switzerland, in establishing its own restitution laws. The legislation was introduced by a lawmaker from Brothers of Italy, the right-wing populist political party in Italy that is currently the country’s ruling party, led by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni.
The Art Newspaper reports that if the bill is considered, a five-member committee will be established by government officials, giving the committee the task of examining the provenance of works between 1933 and 1945 that were confiscated, looted, or sold under duress.
“Introducing this bill does not merely mean finally bringing Italy into line with the highest international standards … but [it] means, first and foremost, fulfilling a historic duty,” Federico Mollicone, member of the chamber of deputies of Italy and president of the culture commission in Italy’s lower house of parliament, told TAN.
Mollicone introduced the bill in March and said that this law is not “merely talking about property claims” but a larger conversation to be had around “restoring human dignity, memory and the fundamental principles of our constitution.”
Compared to other European countries, Italy has lacked pace in developing restitution protocols for dispossessed Jews. “Italy is obviously a central country in the world of art … and yet on this issue of the Holocaust restitution, it had barely scratched the surface in addressing it,” Gideon Taylor, the president of World Jewish Restitution Organisation, told TAN. France’s restitution and compensation committee was created in 1999, and in 2000, the UK established its Spoliation Advisory Panel, an advisory body that works on cultural property looted during the Nazi era.
However, passing such legislation in Italy is bound to be a challenge, as works held in Italian museums are recognized as inalienable parts of the national heritage under the law. The bill that Mollicone has proposed argues that the final restitution decision would remove the work from public domain and the protections of Italy’s heritage code, potentially resulting in the works leaving the country. Mollicone said his goal is to “complete the parliamentary review and pass the bill in the coming months. We want to bring this historic reform to a successful conclusion within this legislative session.”

https://taz.de/Eishockey-WM-in-Deutschla.title: Eishockey-WM in Deutschland: Ein Tor für Russland
https://taz.de/Eishockey-WM-in-Deutschla.author: Andreas Rüttenauer
https://taz.de/Eishockey-WM-in-Deutschla.text:
Eishockey-WM in Deutschland : Ein Tor für Russland
Das internationale Sportschiedsgericht hat entschieden: Russland darf ran an den WM-Puck. Unpolitischer wird der Sport dadurch kaum.
D ie Russen kommen. Im Mai 2027 werden sie in Deutschland auflaufen. Das internationale Sportschiedsgericht (CAS) hat den Ausschluss russischer Teams von Turnieren des Internationalen Eishockeyverbands für nichtig erklärt. Stolz berichten russische Medien vom Ende des Banns, der nach dem Überfall der Russischen Föderation auf die Ukraine im Februar 2022 über den russischen Eishockeysport verhängt worden war.
Die Zeit, in der die Politik des Westens in den Sport hineinregiert hat, sei nun endlich vorbei, jubiliert etwa der russische Sportminister Michail Degtjarjow. Im Juli hatte das Internationale Olympische Komitee den Sportverbänden empfohlen, alle Sanktionen gegen den russischen Sport, die nach dem brutalen Angriff Russlands auf die Ukraine verhängt worden waren, zu streichen. Russland sollte bis zu den Olympischen Sommerspielen in Los Angeles möglichst vollständig rehabilitiert sein.
Auch im IOC wird man wissen, dass das Kriegsgeschehen in der Ukraine keinen Grund dafür liefert, die Sanktionen aufzuheben. Der Drohnen- und Raketenkrieg, auch gegen zivile Ziele in der Ukraine, ist in diesem Jahr noch einmal brutaler und tödlicher geworden als in den Jahren zuvor. Nach wie vor machen Russen ganze Städte dem Erdboden gleich. Auch Hunderte Sportler sind in der Ukraine dem Krieg zum Opfer gefallen. Aber mit all dem will sich das IOC nicht weiter belasten. Die Sportler sollten nicht dafür bezahlen, was ihre Regierungen anrichten, so begründet das IOC seine Entscheidung.
taz debatte
Die taz ist eine unabhängige, linke und meinungsstarke Tageszeitung. In unseren Kommentaren, Essays und Debattentexten streiten wir seit der Gründung der taz im Jahr 1979. Oft können und wollen wir uns nicht auf eine Meinung einigen. Deshalb finden sich hier teils komplett gegenläufige Positionen – allesamt Teil des sehr breiten linken Meinungsspektrums.
Russland, das trotz des Banns seiner nationalen Symbole aus allen Stadien bei internationalen Wettbewerben immer gut vernetzt blieb in der Sportwelt, hat sich durchgesetzt mit seiner Lobbyarbeit. Der Preis für diesen Sieg am grünen Tisch könnte jedoch hoch sein. Der Krieg gegen die Ukraine wird bei jedem internationalen Wettbewerb mit russischer Beteiligung zum Thema gemacht werden. Das Ziel, mit der Wiederzulassung russischer Athleten den Sport zu entpolitisieren, wird das IOC jedenfalls nicht erreichen.
Russische Sportler*innen wurden nicht vermisst
Die Diskussionen um die Eishockey-WM laufen schon jetzt, fast ein halbes Jahr vor Turnierbeginn, auf Hochtouren. Der Eishockeyverband aus Finnland, wo der Pucksport eine Art Nationalreligion darstellt, hat schon angekündigt, nicht gegen Russland antreten zu wollen. Lettischen Sportlern ist es per Gesetz verboten, gegen russische Sportler anzutreten. Auch Lettland ist bei der Eishockey-WM im kommenden Mai dabei.
Aber dürfen überhaupt alle russischen Eishockeyspieler einreisen? Die Turn-WM vor zwei Wochen in Rotterdam fand ohne die russische Ausnahmeturnerin Angelina Melnikowa statt. Die junge Frau, die bei einer regionalen Wahl mal für die Kreml-Partei Einiges Russland kandidiert hatte, bekam kein Visum von den Niederlanden. Wird das deutsche Außenministerium den russischen Superstar und bekennenden Putinfreund Alexander Owetschkin ins Land lassen? Und wird ihm im Falle eines Aufeinandertreffens ein deutscher Nationalspieler nach dem Spiel die Hand schütteln? Nein, unpolitischer wird der Sport gewiss nicht durch die Wiederzulassung von Teams aus Russland.
Genau das war das aus russischer Sicht so Bittere an den Sportsanktionen, die nun nicht mehr gelten. Zwei Olympische Spiele haben seit 2022 stattgefunden, ohne dass die russische Hymne erklungen ist. Vor allem die Sommerspiele 2024 in Paris wurden in fast aller Welt als wunderbares Weihefest des Sports gefeiert. In Paris hat niemand russische Sportlerinnen und Sportler vermisst. Das war eine harte Strafe für den russischen Sport und das russische Selbstbewusstsein. Schade, dass sie jetzt nicht mehr angewendet wird.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/colunist.title: Teatro em campanha: movimento, mobilização e política
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/colunist.author: Cia Burlesca
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/colunist.text:
Fazer teatro exige mobilização! Muito já se falou, aliás, ainda se fala sobre como incentivar a cultura de ir ao teatro. O prédio mesmo, a estrutura em si. Porque sabemos, inclusive fazemos, o tipo de teatro que vai lá onde o povo está. Pois bem, inventamos de fazer uma minitemporada de retomada do nosso amado espetáculo “O Longe”. Escolhemos as datas que tinham, o final de semana entre os turnos de eleição. Para sermos mais precisas, a semana fatídica pós o primeiro turno, onde estávamos restaurando as nossas forças para retomar a luta!
Em parceria com a Casa dos 4 apresentamos três dias de casa cheia. O segredo foi a mobilização de amigos e amigas com recurso pagarem ingressos de grupos interessados e interessantes. Uma turma de estudantes do Instituto Federal de Brasília (IFB) do Recanto das Emas e um grupo de mulheres da Aliança Social Continental (ASC), uma rede que reúne movimentos sociais, sindicais e organizações de diversos países do hemisfério americano contra o fascismo. A temporada foi independente e só foi possível com a ajuda de muita gente. Teatro é movimento, mobilização, política.
Professoras, estudantes, amigos e amigas de longa data, militantes de movimentos sociais e sindicais, familiares e público espontâneo se reuniram na aconchegante Sala Alexandre Ribondi. A história da peça é narrada por uma menina e uma avó em situação de refúgio. As atrocidades do capital internacional são escancaradas, desumanizando pessoas desterritorializadas. Mas é na relação de afeto e cuidado entre avó e menina que a dignidade humana é mantida. Nós, juntas e juntos, o grupo e a plateia, de alguma forma nos reestabelecemos ali, a cada dia, a cada apresentação.
A bilheteria organizada, cheia de adesivos do Lula fazia com que a plateia toda estivesse em campanha. Ao final de cada peça dialogávamos com o público e não tinha como o “Olê, olê, Olê, olá, Lula, Lula” não sair em coro emocionado de todos nós presentes. O espetáculo e a campanha ocupavam os assuntos do espaço externo ao teatro. Os vídeos de teatro invisível que circulavam na internet eram assuntos mencionados como instrumento eficiente. A vida e a arte entrelaçadas, como tem que ser!
Passado o final de semana intenso com espetáculo e o maravilhoso ato com Lula em Ceilândia, na terça-feira o museu se encheu com cerca de 100 mil pessoas. Ato puxado pelos estudantes. Ouvia-se o burburinho da dúvida se em Brasília seria tão grande como tinham sido em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador e tantos outros lugares. E foi imenso no DF também. A emoção tomava conta com a esperança se alargando por todos os lados para virar a história.
Na quarta-feira, chegamos a Taguatinga, no Teatro Paulo Autran, para participar do 2º Festival de Teatro do Distrito Federal. A imensa campanha de alfabetização cubana que erradicou o analfabetismo em 1961 no país inteiro é o tema da peça que iríamos apresentar. Todas as pessoas envolvidas no Festival estavam com uma energia vibrante, uma mistura de medo e esperança com o que víamos acontecer em todo o país.
A extrema direita não recuava, após um lindo ato na Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE) em apoio ao Lula, um incêndio criminoso tomou conta de um prédio, destruindo longos processos de pesquisa. Uma cena aterrorizante. A urgência da luta estava exposta!
“A Aurora”, nosso espetáculo sobre a campanha de alfabetização, também narra sobre o lado opositor. Na cena de nome “algozes da educação”, o período de queima de livros na Alemanha é relacionado com a perseguição ao Paulo Freire no Brasil, assim como, com os livros perseguidos na atualidade e com os símbolos do fascismo, como a tiara de flores. Esta que viralizou no último período com um vídeo da deputada da extrema direita eleita andando pela rua com um chicote na mão.
Enquanto isso, o Janones organizava o exército do Lula e nós em cena falávamos sobre o exército de alfabetizadores da campanha cubana! Enquanto o povo brasileiro dialogava com todas as pessoas que era possível para virar mais um voto, em cena uma brigadista alfabetizava mais uma pessoa! De um em um, uma multidão.
Após a apresentação, dialogamos com as pessoas que tinham ido assistir, todas adesivadas e com bandeira do Lula. Com os olhos brilhantes em ouvir uma história de uma campanha exitosa, trocamos em como manter e ampliar o diálogo nas escolas. Como não abrir mão destes territórios de construção humana! E, sim, ao mesmo tempo conferindo se havia mais uma missão a cumprir do Exército do Lula. Guerra? Isso! Pela democracia, pela vida. Sem fuzil. Com palavras, sentimento, ação coletiva.
Com os corações em festa, seguimos a semana de campanha com bandeiraços, banquinhas de vira voto, teatro Imagem, tarefas do Exército do Lula, Agitação e Propaganda e tantas outras milhares de formas criativas que fomos vendo por todos os lados.
No domingo, fomos mais uma vez encher o Museu da República com nossos gritos em defesa da democracia, onde a ETPVP-DF fez uma potente cena de Teatro Imagem. Na parte da tarde, seguimos para a Cozinha Solidária do MTST no Sol Nascente para contribuir com uma oficina de teatro para as mulheres do projeto Periferia pelas Mulheres. A cena contou com as mulheres falando das políticas públicas em meio a um potente coro de mulheres cantando:
“Somos feitas pra viver, somos feitas pra viver com saúde e moradia, somos feitas pra viver”.
Seguimos para Taguatinga e a semana Burlesca concluiu com um grande presente, o reconhecimento de Direção Destaque do espetáculo “A Aurora” feita por Patrícia Barros e Lyvian Sena. Ganhamos este reconhecimento junto com outras tantas trabalhadoras e trabalhadores do teatro. Cada um que subia ao palco derramava sobre nós palavras de esperança e luta! Vencemos, amigas e amigos, vencemos!
“Ao final da campanha de alfabetização a população se reuniu na praça central da capital, a praça da Revolução José Martí, para erguer juntos uma bandeira com a frase ‘Cuba Território Livre de Analfabetismo’. Os mais de cem mil brigadistas gritavam: ‘“’Diga o que mais temos que fazer!! / Diga o que mais temos que fazer!!!'” – trecho do espetáculo “A Aurora”.
**Este é um artigo de opinião. A visão do autor não necessariamente expressa a linha do editorial do jornal Brasil de Fato – DF.
*Lyvian Sena e Julie Wetzel são integrantes da Cia Burlesca.

https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/su.title: Chinese Artist Sun Xun’s ‘Magic Atlas’ Is First Animated Feature in Tokyo International Film Fest Competition
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/su.author: Harrison Jacobs
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/su.text:
Chinese artist and filmmaker Sun Xun never expected “Magic Atlas” to become the first animated feature selected for the Tokyo International Film Festival’s competition.
“I never thought of ‘Magic Atlas’ as an animated film. To me, it brings together many art forms. Animation is simply the label we use for its form. I’m glad people at TIFF understood the effort I put into it,” Sun tells Variety.
	“Magic Atlas,” a decade in the making, is set in Luocha, a coal-mining empire where flying is forbidden. Every 60 years, a festival leaves the population unable to remember the era that came before. After a magician is arrested, he meets an orphan boy in prison and gives him the Magic Atlas. The book points the boy toward a past the empire has tried to erase.
The film moves between woodblock prints, ink painting and vivid color. Its images often do the work that a conventional plot might spell out, drawing on art and visual traditions from different periods and cultures.
	
Sun says the film was shaped by global events, including the pandemic and the war in Ukraine, as well as personal changes such as his conversion to Buddhism. He put all his savings into the project. When galleries shut down during the pandemic, his art sales dried up. He says he had to find buyers himself and take out loans to keep the film going.
“In my own artistic thinking, I believe every creator should have one ‘all-in’ moment in their life: to make a defining work that takes everything out of them. For me, ‘Magic Atlas’ was that all-in moment,” he says. “I hoped to finish it before my child grew up and while my parents were still alive. Sadly, my father passed away a year before the film was completed.”
Rather than comment on any one event, Sun says, he drew on different cultural and political influences to reflect the divisions he sees around the world. He also brought in images of ancient civilizations, including the pyramids, alongside mythological elements.
“Film cannot address reality directly, but it can take a wider view. It can express how we understand the world and what we are curious about,” he says.
Asked whether films need to explain their stories clearly, Sun says: “I’m actually against ‘story.’ I don’t mean that films shouldn’t have stories. I object to films that emphasize story for the sake of packaging and commercial purposes. As an art form, film should express a state of being.”
Sun names Andrei Tarkovsky, citing 1983’s “Nostalghia,” and the late Hungarian filmmaker Béla Tarr as filmmakers he admires. “They are sincere in the way they approach existence. They don’t rely only on imagined narratives. To me, that is the kind of artistic form cinema should have,” he says.
	While working on “Magic Atlas,” Sun studied Dunhuang murals, Song dynasty painting and calligraphy, along with imagery from other cultures. Asked if he worries that some viewers might find the film difficult to follow, he says: “There will always be a barrier to entry. Ten years of work naturally gives the film depth. But I made this important work for myself. My goal was to realize it, not to please every viewer.”
Sun says exhibitions connected to “Magic Atlas” are planned in the U.S. and Singapore, though venues and dates have not been unveiled. He has also begun a new feature he calls “All or Nothing,” whose Mandarin title, “Fuyou,” means “Mayfly.” The film will continue the world of “Magic Atlas,” moving from the broad theme of forgetting to an individual experience of memory loss. Sun says he filmed the first shot at an exhibition space in Hangzhou and hopes to finish the feature within two years.

https://taz.de/Neuer-Lucky-Luke-Band/!62.title: Neuer Lucky-Luke-Band: Muh! Der Lucky-Kult geht um
https://taz.de/Neuer-Lucky-Luke-Band/!62.author: Ralph Trommer
https://taz.de/Neuer-Lucky-Luke-Band/!62.text:
Neuer Lucky-Luke-Band: Muh! Der Lucky-Kult geht um
Als Lucky Luke aus dem Hotel tritt, begegnen ihm lauter Doppelgänger. Alle tragen Blau – Gelb – Schwarz, dazu ein rotes Halstuch. Was ist geschehen?
Der „Lukismus“ greift um sich! Nachdem Lucky Luke Banditen daran gehindert hat, den Kirchentresor (!) zu plündern, preist ihn der Pastor als Heiligen an. Und begründet damit im Örtchen „Faith“ in Kansas wie auch im benachbarten „Beliefs Junction“ einen neuen Kult, der dem bescheidenen Cowboy so gar nicht passt.
Bei einer Versammlung wird er als Hirte bezeichnet, und das Volk drückt seine Freude mit inbrünstigen „Muh!“-Rufen aus.
Lucky Luke hat in seinem reichen Cowboyleben schon so einiges erlebt – von der Errichtung der Eisenbahn über beinharte Familienfehden bis zum Goldrausch –, doch einen Kult um seine eigene Person hätte er sich wohl bis dato nicht vorstellen können.
Der Comic
„Heiliger Lucky!“. „Lucky Luke“, Band 103, Zeichnungen: Achdé, Text: Jul, nach Morris. Aus dem Französischen von Klaus Jöken. Egmont Verlag Berlin, 48 S., 6,99 Euro (Softcover), 15 Euro (Hardcover)
„Heiliger Lucky“ nennt sich das neueste Abenteuer um den beliebten Comichelden. Es ist schon das sechste Gemeinschaftswerk des französischen Autorenteams Achdé (Zeichnungen) und Jul (Szenario). Für die sorgfältige Übersetzung zeichnet Klaus Jöken verantwortlich.
Kein Messias
Diesmal nehmen sie das Phänomen gesellschaftlicher Bewegungen aufs Korn, die pseudo-religiöse Personenkulte betreiben und vermeintliche Heilsbringer an ihre Spitze stellen. Lucky Luke misstraut derartigen Vergötterungen natürlich sofort, er will weder als Messias gelten noch bedeutet ihm Geld etwas.
Anders die Propagandisten des Lukismus, die hinter der Maske ehrbarer Bürgerlichkeit oder Frömmigkeit die Gelegenheit wittern, große Mengen an Geld in die eigenen Taschen zu scheffeln.
Das besonders geschäftstüchtige Ehepaar Creed (herrlich bieder von Achdé karikiert) will gar den benachbarten friedlichen Pawnee-Indianern das Land wegnehmen. Für diesen Zweck ist es sogar bereit, ein Pockenvirus freizusetzen.
Zum 80. Geburtstag
Lucky Luke, der Cowboy mit seinem treuen Hengst Jolly Jumper, feiert gerade seinen 80. Geburtstag. Am 14. November 1946 erschien erstmals ein Comic mit ihm im „Spirou Almanach 1947“. Sein Schöpfer, der Belgier Maurice de Bevere mit Künstlernamen Morris (1923 2001), lebte sechs Jahre in den Vereinigten Staaten, um gründliche Recherchen anzustellen.
Auch der französische Szenarist René Goscinny (1926 1977) lebte dort, als die beiden sich in New York kennenlernten. Um 1955 wurde daraus eine feste Zusammenarbeit, Goscinny perfektionierte den Humor und das Konzept der Serie.
Achdé und Jul betreuen sie nun zusammen bereits 14 Jahre. Die beiden sind ein eingespieltes Team, das viel Spaß an der Arbeit hat, wie sie es bei der Vorstellung des neuen Bandes in der belgischen Botschaft in Berlin zum Ausdruck brachten. Achdé (Hervé Darmenton) bekundet, dass es „eine besondere Ehre ist, diese Serie weiterführen zu können, die heute zum frankobelgischen Kulturerbe gehört“.
Der 65-Jährige zeichnet die Serie sogar schon seit rund 25 Jahren, Morris selbst hatte ihn als Nachfolger auserkoren.
Historisch genau
Besonderen Wert legt er auf historische Genauigkeit. Dies zeigt sich in seiner Darstellung einer Kirche oder in der Ausgestaltung der Pawnee-Hütten, die nichts mit Wigwam-Zelten zu tun haben. Szenarist Jul (Julien Lucien Berjeaut, geboren 1974) hat Geschichte studiert. Er versteht es, in seinen Storys historische Begebenheiten im Wilden Westen aufzugreifen. Subtil verweist er dabei auf heutige gesellschaftliche Entwicklungen.
So wird auf staatliche Maßnahmen während der Coronapandemie angespielt wie auch auf Verschwörungstheorien und „das Netz“ (hier in Form von Telegrafenmeldungen). Angesichts des schnell um sich greifenden Lukismus liegt es nahe, an den Personenkult um Donald Trump oder die hemmungslose Geldgier so mancher Tech-Milliardäre zu denken.
Jul sieht eine „gefährliche Mischung aus oft fanatischem Glauben und Geldbesitz“ in der Gesellschaft der USA verwurzelt, „die Bible-and-Rifle-Mentalität in den Vereinigten Staaten ist immer noch sehr ausgeprägt.“
Jul ist auf historische Fakten gestoßen, mithilfe derer er seine Idee eines von biblischen Plagen heimgesuchten Ortes untermauern konnte. „In den 1870ern häuften sich die Katastrophen, von Tornados bis zu Dürreperioden, was Strenggläubige oft als Strafe Gottes interpretierten. Ich stieß auf Berichte von verheerenden Heuschreckeninvasionen 1874, die ganze Ernten vernichteten und selbst die Kleider der Bevölkerung auffraßen.“
Aus der Vogelperspektive
Ein gefundenes Fressen auch für Achdé, der die gefährdete Stadt Faith kunstvoll aus der (Vogel-)Perspektive des nahenden Heuschreckenschwarms zeichnet.
Trotz der Verlockungen bleibt Lucky Luke lonesome und bodenständig, am Ende ist er froh, den Wahnsinn überstanden zu haben.
Mit „Heiliger Lucky!“ haben Achdé und Jul ein gelungenes Jubiläumsabenteuer geschaffen, das die über Jahrhunderte sich manifestierenden Widersprüche in der amerikanischen Gesellschaft pointiert zu erklären versteht.
Gemeinsam für freie Presse

https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/n.title: Canada joins coalition refusing to play ice hockey against Russia over Ukraine war
https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/n.author: Guardian staff and agencies
https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/n.text:
Canada has joined a coalition of countries refusing to play ice hockey teams from Russia, with prime minister Mark Carney saying Russian skaters will not be able to compete in a world junior championship next month due to the war in Ukraine.
“While Russia and Belarus are supporting this illegal, unjustified, horrific war in Ukraine, as long as that’s going on, there will be none of those athletes competing for their countries in Canada,” Carney told reporters on Tuesday.
Carney’s comments follow announcements by a growing number of national hockey federations that they will not play Russian teams, after a decision by the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) to allow Russians to compete in International Ice Hockey Federation (IHF) events.
An IIHF ban on Russian teams took effect after Moscow began its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and has been extended annually.
After several appeals by Russia’s hockey federation, the CAS finally lifted the ban on Friday, contending safety and security worries “were not supported by sufficient evidence”.
On Monday, the Finnish Ice Hockey Association asked other nations to stand up against the decision. Federations representing Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Latvia and the Czech Republic announced Tuesday they sided with Finland.
Ukraine’s foreign minister Andrii Sybiha on Tuesday thanked European nations for “refusing to share the ice with Russia”.
“If CAS lacks a moral compass, let’s show that hockey still has values,” he said in a post on X. “Refuse to play against Russia and deny visas to its players. Keep Russia off the ice! A war of aggression and hockey are incompatible.”
The Norwegians were the first to announce on Tuesday their intention to play games in tournaments against all teams but those involving Russia.
“Our position that Russia should be excluded from all international championships as long as the war in Ukraine continues … remains unchanged,” Norway’s federation posted to social media.
“At this time, this decision is based on our responsibility to protect the safety and wellbeing of our players, team staff and their families. We believe playing against Russia under the current circumstances could expose our players and team staff to significant security risks.”
Similar statements followed from the other three nations.
The CAS ruling has left cities worldwide to decide whether they will host upcoming tournaments, as planned, should Russians compete as the war continues in Ukraine.
The world junior tournament is scheduled to begin 26 December in Alberta.

https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/fr.title: France Opens War Crimes Investigation into Israeli Bombing of Beirut that Killed Artist Ali Cherri’s Parents
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/fr.author: Tessa Solomon
https://www.artnews.com/art-news/news/fr.text:
In an apparent legal first, the French War Crimes Unit has opened an investigation into the 2024 Israeli bombing of a Beirut residential building where the family of French Lebanese filmmaker and artist Ali Cherri lived. The announcement comes six months after Cherri and the Paris-based International Federation for Human Rights (FIDH) filed a complaint alleging that the Israeli military intentionally targeted a civilian structure, killing seven people, including the artist’s parents, which amounted to a war crime.
The complaint centers on the Israeli military’s bombing of a residential building in Beirut’s Noueiri neighborhood, just hours before a ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah was set to take effect. The strike destroyed the ninth-floor apartment home to the artist’s parents, Mahmoud Naim Cherri and Nadira Hayek, as well as Birki Negesa, a domestic worker employed by the couple. The building’s seventh and eighth floors were also destroyed.
“To our knowledge, this is the very first judicial investigation opened into the crimes committed by the Israeli army in Lebanon since October 2023,” said Clémence Bectarte, lawyer and coordinator of the FIDH Litigation Action Group. “We hope that this investigation will shed full light on the bombing of 26 November 2024, which we qualified as a war crime in our complaint.”
Cherri, who lives and works between Paris and Beirut, is one of Lebanon’s most prominent contemporary artists. He received the Silver Lion at the 2022 Venice Biennale, where he showed his sculpture triad Titans and video installation Of Men and Gods and Mud (both 2022) in the main exhibition, “The Milk of Dreams,” curated by Cecilia Alemani. His recent exhibition at Almine Rech in New York, “Last Watch Before Dawn,” continued a longstanding preoccupation of his practice: the archaeology of conflict and its excavation in the mind and political memory.
As Cherri holds dual French and Lebanese nationality, the judicial investigation will focus only on the bombing of the apartment. According to the FIDH, the French courts do not have jurisdiction over the events that led to the deaths of the victims, who were not French nationals.
“The opening of this judicial investigation marks another important step in our fight against impunity and our struggle for justice for those who were killed. For my family and me, it is essential that this investigation establish responsibility, and ensure that those who ordered and carried out this bombing are held accountable for their actions,” Cherri said in a statement.
Israel launched a military campaign in Lebanon in September 2024, saying it aimed to target the Iran-allied militant group Hezbollah. The campaign involved aerial bombardments across the Beirut region and a ground invasion of southern Lebanon, displacing roughly 1 million people. In April, the UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) reported that Israeli forces had committed nearly 10,000 violations of the ceasefire agreement in less than a year, including more than 500 airstrikes in Lebanon, carried out on an “almost daily” basis. The UN also warned of a “mounting toll of civilian deaths and injuries.”
Israel has consistently rejected accusations that it has violated the ceasefire, characterizing its actions in southern Lebanon as responses to what it describes as violations by Hezbollah.

https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2.title: Google says there’s no way to use Search without using artificial intelligence
https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2.author: Johana Bhuiyan
https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2.text:
Google just acknowledged that you can’t use Google Search without using artificial intelligence.
The search giant announced a slate of new AI products for classrooms and schools on Tuesday as well as more ways for teachers and schools to limit or restrict use of those AI tools. The company said the schools should have control over whether students use AI in the classroom. There’s one catch, though: if a school or teacher blocks the use of Google’s AI features, students won’t be able to use Google Search.
“After listening to schools, teachers, leading researchers, and policymakers, we are now updating our approach to controls for Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Google Search,” company executives wrote in a blogpost. “Access to these products will be entirely off for K-12 student accounts until school administrators explicitly turn them on.”
In a comment to the New York Times, Chris Phillips, Google’s vice-president for education, said that there is no Google Search without AI.
“Search and AI are deeply integrated,” said Phillips. A school-wide ban on AI would mean that students “will not have access to search, and they’ll see a message from their school that indicates it’s not available”, he told the Times. The Guardian also reached out to Google but did not hear back by publication.
To some, the move reads like a penalty for not implementing Google’s AI features.
New York City’s mayor, Zohran Mamdani, who recently imposed a one-year moratorium on generative AI tools in city schools through the eighth grade, said Google was exploiting its near-total control of online search.
“Google is trying to use its monopoly power to force AI into our public schools,” Mamdani posted on X. “No corporation should have the power to dictate how we teach our children. Our public schools exist to serve students, not to grow the profit margins of Big Tech.” Lina Khan, former chair of the US Federal Trade Commission, echoed his statement, tweeting that Google was using its monopoly on search to “to coerce schools into adopting AI”.
The ubiquity of Google Search has long made it a critical tool for students, and losing access to it may prove enough of a reason to opt in to using new AI features for schools. Google has also maintained a stranglehold on technology in US classrooms for years by offering cheap and free products. From Gmail and Google Docs to Google Classroom and Google Chromebooks, the company’s suite of software and hardware solutions are among the most widely used in schools.
One of the new features Google announced today was Guided Learning, an AI study tool that “coaches students through the process of problem solving” rather than giving them the answer. The company is planning to integrate Guided Learning directly into Google Search.
“For example, if a student pastes a complex physics problem or asks for help writing a book report in Search, they’ll see prompts to help them think critically and work through the concepts, without going directly to the answer,” the company wrote in a blogpost.
Lila Byock, founder of Schools Beyond Screens, called Google’s announcement a “hostile ultimatum”. Schools Beyond Screens is a national coalition of parents and teachers advocating for more student-centered policies on the use of screens in schools.
“This kind of bullying has no place in our schools,” Byock said in a statement. “Educational value – not shareholder value – must determine which products are used by students and regulators must intervene to prevent big tech from exploiting schoolchildren for profit.”

https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.title: Even if US democracy can be salvaged from Trump, Europe is moving on | Rafael Behr
https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.author: Rafael Behr
https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfre.text:
When Joe Biden entered the White House in 2021 it was possible to believe that Donald Trump’s reign had been an aberration. “America is back. The transatlantic alliance is back,” the new president declared to relieved European leaders shortly after winning the 2020 race. It was true, but not for long.
Trump’s defeat proved that US democracy was mechanically operational, not culturally robust. His supporters tried violent subversion to prevent the inauguration of a successor. A second term should have been unthinkable. Republicans who failed to denounce the 6 January insurrection should have been unelectable. Instead, within four years, US voters reinstated the champion of a failed coup against their cherished constitution as commander-in-chief.
That is worth remembering in any analysis of midterm congressional elections. Voting was under way at the time of writing. Opinion polls in the run-up favoured Democrats. But it is a measure of how grievously Trump has imperilled democracy that peaceful completion of that process, followed by a fair count, cannot be anticipated with confidence.
The most that can be said is that the elections were not aborted, nor did they look blatantly rigged on the eve of polling, which gives hope that the balloting process can still function in theory. That is no protection against a president with a record of denying results that displease him and a party that cravenly endorses every lie and coercion he deploys to consolidate his power.
With two years left in his second term, Trump has ample scope to punish disloyalty and reward sycophants. Facing a choice between election integrity and partisan venality, precedent suggests few Republicans prefer the path of constitutional virtue. That moral collapse in the ruling party is salient for some voters, but that group – the anti-tyranny constituency – were always going to vote Democrat. In the swing-voting middle, Trump is a drag on the Republicans because people feel let down on the economy and disrespected by a president who is more interested in the construction of a White House ballroom for himself than the affordability of everyday goods for everyone else.
A disciplined and sophisticated fascist would have focused on suffocating domestic opposition and dismantling institutional checks on the presidency, instead of launching a strategically inept and economically self-sabotaging war against Iran. That miscalculation has damaged Trump. It upset “America first” ideologues who thought he stood against forever wars in the Middle East. By precipitating closure of the strait of Hormuz, it landed higher bills on voters whose motive for voting Republican in 2024 had been the spike in inflation preceding that poll.
Democrats can’t afford to be fussy about different flavours of anti-Trump vote. If the economy is what people care about, that is the campaign to run. If a quixotic, megalomaniac foreign policy choice made in February leads indirectly to the election of a Congress better equipped to hold a rogue president to account, that would obviously be better than the scenario where the same failure passes with impunity.
But it leaves the argument incomplete in the same way that Biden’s 2020 victory was insufficiently decisive. The case that defenders of US democracy still haven’t landed is the one that explains Trump’s bad decisions as the inevitable consequence of his beliefs, not just disappointing meanders away off the true path.
If US society were truly and passionately wedded to the principles enshrined in its constitution, a campaign exposing Trump as a persistent aggressor against that foundational ethos would be unbeatable. But it has been tried and beaten.
Before Biden stepped down mid-race in 2024, he sought to frame his bid for re-election as an existential contest for the soul of the US political system. Trump was a despot, he said, whose embrace of the 6 January insurrection was a clear disqualification from ever being allowed near the Oval Office again. “Whether democracy is still America’s sacred cause is the most urgent question of our time,” he told a rally in Pennsylvania. When Kamala Harris took over as the Democratic nominee, she made the same point. Trump was “unhinged and unstable”, seeking “unchecked power”, she said weeks before polling day. America decided the price of eggs was a more pressing concern.
Perhaps Trump’s second term can achieve what the first one didn’t. Maybe the extra exposure to a more virulent strain of the virus is generating antibodies in the US body politic that the initial four-year dose couldn’t produce. If so, we won’t have proof of it any time soon. A nation that swerves dictatorship by luck, because the aspiring dictator lacked the strategic acumen to complete his mission, doesn’t look immune for the long term.
It is a lesson US allies learned from the false comfort they took when Biden said the old America was back. Slowly, European democracies are adapting to a world in which they cannot assume US friendship. Reliance on the US defence umbrella and advanced technology is now recognised as a strategic vulnerability to be urgently addressed.
For Britain, Trump is an engine driving closer integration with Europe. His trade policy, combining innumerate protectionism and territorial rapacity, has destroyed the flimsy case for Brexit that posited nonexistent transatlantic deals as alternatives to the EU single market. White House indulgence of Vladimir Putin and scorn for Nato makes it hard to credibly sustain the idea of UK leverage through a “special relationship” with Washington.
Some restoration of trust in a post-Trump America is feasible. But so is the spread of Trumpian nationalism through Europe. The election of far-right governments could strain and ultimately even break postwar 20th-century institutions that were founded with vows of determination never again to let enemies of liberal democracy plunge the continent into spirals of hatred and war.
That history was meant to be an inoculation on both sides of the Atlantic. But when it mattered, the 20th-century parables didn’t sway US voters. The warnings went unheeded when familiar authoritarian intent appeared, lightly camouflaged in modern celebrity style, speaking in all-American idiom. The challenge now for European democrats is to study that lesson – the cautionary tale of America’s fragile defences against tyranny in the 21st century – and turn it into campaigns that prevent the same thing happening here.
- Rafael Behr is a Guardian columnist
